(1) The center twist multiplies every τ-link leaving one slice x_τ = t₀ by z. It leaves every plaquette, and hence every plaquette action (Wilson or otherwise, no class-function hypothesis), exactly invariant. (2) The Polyakov loop P_b (from accepted pr-12) is gauge covariant, P_b(gU) = g_b P_b(U) g_b⁻¹. The twist of the slice through b multiplies it by z, P_b ↦ z P_b. So χ(P_b) is gauge invariant for class functions χ, yet charged under the center. (3) Selection rule: let E be any ℂ-linear expectation on observables that is invariant under the twist. If χ(z h) = ω χ(h) with ω ≠ 1 (e.g. χ = tr in the fundamental of SU(N), z = e^{2πi/N}), then E(χ∘P_b) = 0. This is the lattice form of the statement that an unbroken center symmetry forces a vanishing Polyakov-loop expectation, the classic confinement order parameter ('t Hooft; Svetitsky–Yaffe). (4) Applying pr-12's axial gauge to the twisted configuration, the residual last-slice link equals z times the original Polyakov loop. The twist is visible exactly in the gauge-fixed residual data. Item (2) also supplies the precise covariance statement that the pr-12 review asked for: the Polyakov element is covariant by conjugation, and its class-function evaluations are invariant.\",\"kind\":\"lemma\",\"research_direction\":\"Lattice regularization route: formal center symmetry and Polyakov-loop order parameter for confinement\",\"provenance\":{\"mode\":\"formalization\",\"sources\":[{\"reference\":\"https://doi.org/10.1016/0550-3213(78)90153-0\",\"title\":\"On the phase transition towards permanent quark confinement\",\"authors\":[\"Gerard 't Hooft\"],\"relationship\":\"Source of center symmetry in gauge theory; the lattice twist formalized here is its standard realization.\",\"priority_evidence\":\"Published in Nuclear Physics B 138 (1978); classical, no priority claimed.\"},{\"reference\":\"https://doi.org/10.1016/0550-3213(82)90172-9\",\"title\":\"Critical behavior at finite-temperature confinement transitions\",\"authors\":[\"Benjamin Svetitsky\",\"Laurence G. (1) The center twist multiplies every τ-link leaving one slice x_τ = t₀ by z. It leaves every plaquette, and hence every plaquette action (Wilson or otherwise, no class-function hypothesis), exactly invariant. (2) The Polyakov loop P_b (from accepted pr-12) is gauge covariant, P_b(gU) = g_b P_b(U) g_b⁻¹. The twist of the slice through b multiplies it by z, P_b ↦ z P_b. So χ(P_b) is gauge invariant for class functions χ, yet charged under the center. (3) Selection rule: let E be any ℂ-linear expectation on observables that is invariant under the twist. If χ(z h) = ω χ(h) with ω ≠ 1 (e.g. χ = tr in the fundamental of SU(N), z = e^{2πi/N}), then E(χ∘P_b) = 0. This is the lattice form of the statement that an unbroken center symmetry forces a vanishing Polyakov-loop expectation, the classic confinement order parameter ('t Hooft; Svetitsky–Yaffe). (4) Applying pr-12's axial gauge to the twisted configuration, the residual last-slice link equals z times the original Polyakov loop. The twist is visible exactly in the gauge-fixed residual data. (4) Applying pr-12's axial gauge to the twisted configuration, the residual last-slice link equals z times the original Polyakov loop. The twist is visible exactly in the gauge-fixed residual data.   "source": "namespace Contribution\n\nopen B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution\n\nvariable {G : Type} [Group G] {d L : ℕ}\n\n/-- Ordered product `U_{b,τ} U_{b+τ,τ} ⋯ U_{b+(k-1)τ,τ}` of the first `k` links on the\n`τ`-line starting at `b`. -/\ndef linePath (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : ℕ → G\n  | 0 => 1\n  | k + 1 => linePath U b τ k * U (b + k • e τ) τ\n\n/-- The Polyakov loop: the holonomy once around the periodic `τ`-direction from `b`. -/\ndef polyakovLoop (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : G :=\n  linePath U b τ L\n\n/-- The point of the `τ = 0` slice on the `τ`-line through `x`. -/\ndef sliceBase (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : Site d L :=\n  Function.update x τ 0\n\n/-- The axial-gauge transformation: transport along the `τ`-line from the base slice. -/\ndef axialGauge (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) : GaugeTransform G d L :=\n  fun x => linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ (x τ).val\n\ntheorem linePath_zero (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :\n    linePath U b τ 0 = 1 := rfl\n\ntheorem linePath_succ (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (k : ℕ) :\n    linePath U b τ (k + 1) = linePath U b τ k * U (b + k • e τ) τ := rfl\n\ntheorem e_self (τ : Fin d) : (e τ : Site d L) τ = 1 := by\n  show (Pi.single τ (1 : ZMod L) : Fin d → ZMod L) τ = 1\n  exact Pi.single_eq_same _ _\n\ntheorem e_ne {τ μ : Fin d} (h : μ ≠ τ) : (e τ : Site d L) μ = 0 := by\n  show (Pi.single τ (1 : ZMod L) : Fin d → ZMod L) μ = 0\n  exact Pi.single_eq_of_ne h _\n\ntheorem sliceBase_add_e (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :\n    sliceBase (x + e τ) τ = sliceBase x τ := by\n  funext μ\n  by_cases h : μ = τ\n  · subst h; simp [sliceBase]\n  · simp only [sliceBase, Function.update_of_ne h, Pi.add_apply, e_ne h, add_zero]\n\ntheorem sliceBase_add_val [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :\n    sliceBase x τ + (x τ).val • e τ = x := by\n  funext μ\n  by_cases h : μ = τ\n  · subst h\n    rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, e_self]\n    simp only [sliceBase, Function.update_self, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add,\n      ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]\n  · simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, sliceBase, Function.update_of_ne h, e_ne h,\n      smul_zero, add_zero]\n\ntheorem add_e_apply (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : (x + e τ : Site d L) τ = x τ + 1 := by\n  simp only [Pi.add_apply, e_self]\n\ntheorem val_add_e_of_lt [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (hx : (x τ).val + 1 < L) :\n    ((x + e τ : Site d L) τ).val = (x τ).val + 1 := by\n  rw [add_e_apply, ZMod.val_add, ZMod.val_one_eq_one_mod, Nat.one_mod_eq_one.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_left 1 _) hx)),\n    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx]\n\ntheorem val_add_e_of_last [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (hx : (x τ).val + 1 = L) :\n    ((x + e τ : Site d L) τ).val = 0 := by\n  have h1 : (x + e τ : Site d L) τ = (((x τ).val + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod L) := by\n    rw [add_e_apply]; push_cast; rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]\n  rw [h1, hx, ZMod.natCast_self, ZMod.val_zero]\n\n/-- Away from the last slice, the axial gauge trivializes every `τ`-link. -/\ntheorem axialGauge_link [NeZero L] (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) (x : Site d L)\n    (hx : (x τ).val + 1 < L) : gaugeAct (axialGauge U τ) U x τ = 1 := by\n  simp only [gaugeAct, axialGauge]\n  rw [sliceBase_add_e, val_add_e_of_lt x τ hx, linePath_succ, sliceBase_add_val]\n  exact mul_inv_cancel _\n\n/-- On the last slice, the remaining `τ`-link is the Polyakov loop through `x`. -/\ntheorem axialGauge_last [NeZero L] (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) (x : Site d L)\n    (hx : (x τ).val + 1 = L) :\n    gaugeAct (axialGauge U τ) U x τ = polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ := by\n  simp only [gaugeAct, axialGauge]\n  rw [sliceBase_add_e, val_add_e_of_last x τ hx, linePath_zero, inv_one, mul_one,\n    polyakovLoop, show linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ L =\n      linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ ((x τ).val + 1) from congrArg _ hx.symm,\n    linePath_succ, sliceBase_add_val]\n\n/-- Axial (temporal) gauge on the periodic lattice `(ℤ/Lℤ)^d`, for any gauge group and any\ndirection `τ`: every configuration is gauge equivalent to one whose `τ`-links are trivial off\nthe last slice and equal the Polyakov loops on it; every class-function plaquette action\n(in particular the Wilson action) is unchanged. -/\ntheorem result :\n    ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] (d L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (τ : Fin d) (U : LinkConfig G d L),\n      ∃ g : GaugeTransform G d L,\n        (∀ x : Site d L, (x τ).val + 1 < L → gaugeAct g U x τ = 1) ∧\n        (∀ x : Site d L, (x τ).val + 1 = L →\n          gaugeAct g U x τ = polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ) ∧\n        (∀ f : G → ℝ, IsClassFunction f → latticeAction f (gaugeAct g U) = latticeAction f U) := by\n  intro G _ d L _ τ U\n  refine ⟨axialGauge U τ, fun x hx => axialGauge_link U τ x hx,\n    fun x hx => axialGauge_last U τ x hx, fun f hf => ?_⟩\n  exact (B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution.result).1\n    G d L f hf (axialGauge U τ) U\n\nend Contribution\n",

  "source": "namespace Contribution\n\nopen B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution\n\nvariable {G : Type} [Group G] {d L : ℕ}\n\n/-- Ordered product `U_{b,τ} U_{b+τ,τ} ⋯ U_{b+(k-1)τ,τ}` of the first `k` links on the\n`τ`-line starting at `b`. -/\ndef linePath (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : ℕ → G\n  | 0 => 1\n  | k + 1 => linePath U b τ k * U (b + k • e τ) τ\n\n/-- The Polyakov loop: the holonomy once around the periodic `τ`-direction from `b`. -/\ndef polyakovLoop (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : G :=\n  linePath U b τ L\n\n/-- The point of the `τ = 0` slice on the `τ`-line through `x`. -/\ndef sliceBase (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : Site d L :=\n  Function.update x τ 0\n\n/-- The axial-gauge transformation: transport along the `τ`-line from the base slice. -/\ndef axialGauge (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) : GaugeTransform G d L :=\n  fun x => linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ (x τ).val\n\ntheorem linePath_zero (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :\n    linePath U b τ 0 = 1 := rfl\n\ntheorem linePath_succ (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (k : ℕ) :\n    linePath U b τ (k + 1) = linePath U b τ k * U (b + k • e τ) τ := rfl\n\ntheorem e_self (τ : Fin d) : (e τ : Site d L) τ = 1 := by\n  show (Pi.single τ (1 : ZMod L) : Fin d → ZMod L) τ = 1\n  exact Pi.single_eq_same _ _\n\ntheorem e_ne {τ μ : Fin d} (h : μ ≠ τ) : (e τ : Site d L) μ = 0 := by\n  show (Pi.single τ (1 : ZMod L) : Fin d → ZMod L) μ = 0\n  exact Pi.single_eq_of_ne h _\n\ntheorem sliceBase_add_e (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :\n    sliceBase (x + e τ) τ = sliceBase x τ := by\n  funext μ\n  by_cases h : μ = τ\n  · subst h; simp [sliceBase]\n  · simp only [sliceBase, Function.update_of_ne h, Pi.add_apply, e_ne h, add_zero]\n\ntheorem sliceBase_add_val [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :\n    sliceBase x τ + (x τ).val • e τ = x := by\n  funext μ\n  by_cases h : μ = τ\n  · subst h\n    rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, e_self]\n    simp only [sliceBase, Function.update_self, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add,\n      ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]\n  · simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, sliceBase, Function.update_of_ne h, e_ne h,\n      smul_zero, add_zero]\n\ntheorem add_e_apply (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : (x + e τ : Site d L) τ = x τ + 1 := by\n  simp only [Pi.add_apply, e_self]\n\ntheorem val_add_e_of_lt [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (hx : (x τ).val + 1 < L) :\n    ((x + e τ : Site d L) τ).val = (x τ).val + 1 := by\n  rw [add_e_apply, ZMod.val_add, ZMod.val_one_eq_one_mod, Nat.one_mod_eq_one.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_left 1 _) hx)),\n    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx]\n\ntheorem val_add_e_of_last [NeZero L] (x : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (hx : (x τ).val + 1 = L) :\n    ((x + e τ : Site d L) τ).val = 0 := by\n  have h1 : (x + e τ : Site d L) τ = (((x τ).val + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod L) := by\n    rw [add_e_apply]; push_cast; rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]\n  rw [h1, hx, ZMod.natCast_self, ZMod.val_zero]\n\n/-- Away from the last slice, the axial gauge trivializes every `τ`-link. -/\ntheorem axialGauge_link [NeZero L] (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) (x : Site d L)\n    (hx : (x τ).val + 1 < L) : gaugeAct (axialGauge U τ) U x τ = 1 := by\n  simp only [gaugeAct, axialGauge]\n  rw [sliceBase_add_e, val_add_e_of_lt x τ hx, linePath_succ, sliceBase_add_val]\n  exact mul_inv_cancel _\n\n/-- On the last slice, the remaining `τ`-link is the Polyakov loop through `x`. -/\ntheorem axialGauge_last [NeZero L] (U : LinkConfig G d L) (τ : Fin d) (x : Site d L)\n    (hx : (x τ).val + 1 = L) :\n    gaugeAct (axialGauge U τ) U x τ = polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ := by\n  simp only [gaugeAct, axialGauge]\n  rw [sliceBase_add_e, val_add_e_of_last x τ hx, linePath_zero, inv_one, mul_one,\n    polyakovLoop, show linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ L =\n      linePath U (sliceBase x τ) τ ((x τ).val + 1) from congrArg _ hx.symm,\n    linePath_succ, sliceBase_add_val]\n\n/-- Axial (temporal) gauge on the periodic lattice `(ℤ/Lℤ)^d`, for any gauge group and any\ndirection `τ`: every configuration is gauge equivalent to one whose `τ`-links are trivial off\nthe last slice and equal the Polyakov loops on it; every class-function plaquette action\n(in particular the Wilson action) is unchanged. -/\ntheorem result :\n    ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] (d L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (τ : Fin d) (U : LinkConfig G d L),\n      ∃ g : GaugeTransform G d L,\n        (∀ x : Site d L, (x τ).val + 1 < L → gaugeAct g U x τ = 1) ∧\n        (∀ x : Site d L, (x τ).val + 1 = L →\n          gaugeAct g U x τ = polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ) ∧\n        (∀ f : G → ℝ, IsClassFunction f → latticeAction f (gaugeAct g U) = latticeAction f U) := by\n  intro G _ d L _ τ U\n  refine ⟨axialGauge U τ, fun x hx => axialGauge_link U τ x hx,\n    fun x hx => axialGauge_last U τ x hx, fun f hf => ?_⟩\n  exact (B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution.result).1\n    G d L f hf (axialGauge U τ) U\n\nend Contribution\n",

(1) The center twist multiplies every τ-link leaving one slice x_τ = t₀ by z. It leaves every plaquette, and hence every plaquette action (Wilson or otherwise, no class-function hypothesis), exactly invariant. (2) The Polyakov loop P_b (from accepted pr-12) is gauge covariant, P_b(gU) = g_b P_b(U) g_b⁻¹. The twist of the slice through b multiplies it by z, P_b ↦ z P_b. So χ(P_b) is gauge invariant for class functions χ, yet charged under the center. (3) Selection rule: let E be any ℂ-linear expectation on observables that is invariant under the twist. If χ(z h) = ω χ(h) with ω ≠ 1 (e.g. χ = tr in the fundamental of SU(N), z = e^{2πi/N}), then E(χ∘P_b) = 0. This is the lattice form of the statement that an unbroken center symmetry forces a vanishing Polyakov-loop expectation, the classic confinement order parameter ('t Hooft; Svetitsky–Yaffe). submission.title: Center symmetry on the lattice: twist invariance, Polyakov-loop covariance and the ⟨χ(P)⟩ = 0 selection rule
submission.claim: For any group G, central element z, d, L ≥ 1 and direction τ on the periodic lattice (ℤ/Lℤ)^d, the Lean theorem Contribution.result proves four things. (1) The center twist multiplies every τ-link leaving one slice x_τ = t₀ by z. It leaves every plaquette, and hence every plaquette action (Wilson or otherwise, no class-function hypothesis), exactly invariant. (2) The Polyakov loop P_b (from accepted pr-12) is gauge covariant, P_b(gU) = g_b P_b(U) g_b⁻¹. The twist of the slice through b multiplies it by z, P_b ↦ z P_b. So χ(P_b) is gauge invariant for class functions χ, yet charged under the center. (3) Selection rule: let E be any ℂ-linear expectation on observables that is invariant under the twist. If χ(z h) = ω χ(h) with ω ≠ 1 (e.g. χ = tr in the fundamental of SU(N), z = e^{2πi/N}), then E(χ∘P_b) = 0. This is the lattice form of the statement that an unbroken center symmetry forces a vanishing Polyakov-loop expectation, the classic confinement order parameter ('t Hooft; Svetitsky–Yaffe). (4) Applying pr-12's axial gauge to the twisted configuration, the residual last-slice link equals z times the original Polyakov loop. The twist is visible exactly in the gauge-fixed residual data. Item (2) also supplies the precise covariance statement that the pr-12 review asked for: the Polyakov element is covariant by conjugation, and its class-function evaluations are invariant.

{
  "version": 2,
  "imports": [
    "Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic",
    "Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic",
    "Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LinearMap.Defs"
  ],
  "source": "namespace Contribution

open B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution
open B_4f4126122d0700524796c405e145badf09c1ce0f46ce2280744811f1b2bad118.Contribution

variable {G : Type} [Group G] {d L : ℕ}

/-- `z` lies in the center of `G`. -/
def IsCentral (z : G) : Prop := ∀ h : G, z * h = h * z

/-- The center transformation: right-multiply every `τ`-link leaving the slice `x_τ = t₀`
by `z`. -/
def centerTwist (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) :
    LinkConfig G d L :=
  fun x μ => if μ = τ ∧ x τ = t₀ then U x μ * z else U x μ

theorem twist_ne (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L)
    {μ : Fin d} (h : μ ≠ τ) : centerTwist z τ t₀ U x μ = U x μ :=
  if_neg fun hh => h hh.1

theorem twist_on (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) {x : Site d L}
    {μ : Fin d} (hμ : μ = τ) (h : x τ = t₀) : centerTwist z τ t₀ U x μ = U x μ * z :=
  if_pos ⟨hμ, h⟩

theorem twist_off (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) {x : Site d L}
    {μ : Fin d} (h : x τ ≠ t₀) : centerTwist z τ t₀ U x μ = U x μ :=
  if_neg fun hh => h hh.2

theorem shift_coord (x : Site d L) {τ ν : Fin d} (h : τ ≠ ν) : (x + e ν : Site d L) τ = x τ := by
  rw [Pi.add_apply, e_ne h, add_zero]

theorem cancel_first {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) {a' b' c' f' : G} (a b c f : G)
    (ha : a' = a * z) (hb : b' = b) (hc : c' = c * z) (hf : f' = f) :
    a' * b' * c'⁻¹ * f'⁻¹ = a * b * c⁻¹ * f⁻¹ := by
  rw [ha, hb, hc, hf, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc a z b, hz b, ← mul_assoc a b z, mul_assoc (a * b) z,
    mul_inv_cancel_left]

theorem four_links {a' b' c' f' : G} (a b c f : G)
    (ha : a' = a) (hb : b' = b) (hc : c' = c) (hf : f' = f) :
    a' * b' * c'⁻¹ * f'⁻¹ = a * b * c⁻¹ * f⁻¹ := by
  subst ha hb hc hf; rfl

/-- Plaquettes with first direction `τ` are unchanged by a center twist. -/
theorem plaquette_centerTwist_first {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L)
    (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L) {μ ν : Fin d} (hμ : μ = τ) (hμν : μ ≠ ν) :
    plaquette (centerTwist z τ t₀ U) x μ ν = plaquette U x μ ν := by
  have hντ : ν ≠ τ := fun h => hμν (hμ.trans h.symm)
  by_cases ht : x τ = t₀
  · exact cancel_first hz _ _ _ _ (twist_on z τ t₀ U hμ ht) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hντ)
      (twist_on z τ t₀ U hμ ((shift_coord x (Ne.symm hντ)).trans ht)) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hντ)
  · exact four_links _ _ _ _ (twist_off z τ t₀ U ht) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hντ)
      (twist_off z τ t₀ U (fun h => ht ((shift_coord x (Ne.symm hντ)).symm.trans h)))
      (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hντ)

/-- Every plaquette is unchanged by a center twist. -/
theorem plaquette_centerTwist {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L)
    (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L) (μ ν : Fin d) :
    plaquette (centerTwist z τ t₀ U) x μ ν = plaquette U x μ ν := by
  by_cases hμν : μ = ν
  · cases hμν
    exact (plaquette_self _ x μ).trans (plaquette_self U x μ).symm
  by_cases hμ : μ = τ
  · exact plaquette_centerTwist_first hz τ t₀ U x hμ hμν
  by_cases hν : ν = τ
  · exact (plaquette_swap _ x ν μ).trans ((congrArg (·⁻¹)
      (plaquette_centerTwist_first hz τ t₀ U x hν (Ne.symm hμν))).trans
      (plaquette_swap U x ν μ).symm)
  · exact four_links _ _ _ _ (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hμ) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hν)
      (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hμ) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hν)

/-- Every plaquette action (no class-function hypothesis needed) is center-twist invariant. -/
theorem latticeAction_centerTwist [NeZero L] {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d)
    (t₀ : ZMod L) (f : G → ℝ) (U : LinkConfig G d L) :
    latticeAction f (centerTwist z τ t₀ U) = latticeAction f U := by
  unfold latticeAction
  simp only [plaquette_centerTwist hz]

/-! ### Telescoping along a line (abstract sequences) -/

theorem conj_step (gb P h u j : G) : gb * P * h⁻¹ * (h * u * j⁻¹) = gb * (P * u) * j⁻¹ := by
  rw [mul_assoc h u, mul_assoc (gb * P), inv_mul_cancel_left, ← mul_assoc (gb * P) u,
    ← mul_assoc gb P u]

theorem tele_gauge (g P Q u : ℕ → G) (hP0 : P 0 = 1) (hP : ∀ k, P (k + 1) = P k * u k)
    (hQ0 : Q 0 = 1) (hQ : ∀ k, Q (k + 1) = Q k * (g k * u k * (g (k + 1))⁻¹)) :
    ∀ k, Q k = g 0 * P k * (g k)⁻¹
  | 0 => by rw [hQ0, hP0, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel]
  | k + 1 => by rw [hQ, tele_gauge g P Q u hP0 hP hQ0 hQ k, hP, conj_step]

theorem tele_twist {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (N : ℕ) (P Q u : ℕ → G) (hP0 : P 0 = 1)
    (hP : ∀ k, P (k + 1) = P k * u k) (hQ1 : Q 1 = u 0 * z)
    (hQ : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k < N → Q (k + 1) = Q k * u k) :
    ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ N → Q k = z * P k := by
  intro k hk
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => intro _; rw [hQ1, hP, hP0, one_mul, hz]
  | succ k hk ih =>
    intro hkN
    rw [hQ k hk hkN, ih (Nat.le_of_lt hkN), hP, mul_assoc]

theorem add_L_smul_e [NeZero L] (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : b + L • e τ = b := by
  funext μ
  rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul, add_zero]

theorem shift_succ (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (k : ℕ) :
    b + k • e τ + e τ = b + (k + 1) • e τ :=
  (add_assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (b + ·) (succ_nsmul _ k).symm)

/-- Polyakov loops transform by conjugation at their base point. -/
theorem polyakovLoop_gaugeAct [NeZero L] (g : GaugeTransform G d L) (U : LinkConfig G d L)
    (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :
    polyakovLoop (gaugeAct g U) b τ = g b * polyakovLoop U b τ * (g b)⁻¹ := by
  have h := tele_gauge (fun k => g (b + k • e τ)) (linePath U b τ)
    (linePath (gaugeAct g U) b τ) (fun k => U (b + k • e τ) τ) rfl (fun _ => rfl) rfl
    (fun k => congrArg (fun p => linePath (gaugeAct g U) b τ k *
      (g (b + k • e τ) * U (b + k • e τ) τ * (g p)⁻¹)) (shift_succ b τ k)) L
  rw [polyakovLoop, polyakovLoop, h, zero_smul, add_zero, add_L_smul_e]

theorem coord_ne [NeZero L] (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) {k : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk : k < L) :
    (b + k • e τ : Site d L) τ ≠ b τ := by
  rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, e_self, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  intro h
  have h0 : ((k : ℕ) : ZMod L) = 0 := add_eq_left.mp h
  rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at h0
  exact absurd (Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h0 hk) (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp h1)

/-- A center twist at the slice through `b` multiplies the Polyakov loop at `b` by `z`. -/
theorem polyakovLoop_centerTwist [NeZero L] {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d)
    (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) :
    polyakovLoop (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ = z * polyakovLoop U b τ := by
  have hb0 : (b + (0 : ℕ) • e τ : Site d L) τ = b τ := by rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
  exact tele_twist hz L (linePath U b τ) (linePath (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ)
    (fun k => U (b + k • e τ) τ) rfl (fun _ => rfl)
    ((one_mul _).trans (twist_on z τ (b τ) U rfl hb0))
    (fun k h1 hk => congrArg (linePath (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ k * ·)
      (twist_off z τ (b τ) U (coord_ne b τ h1 hk)))
    L NeZero.one_le le_rfl

/-- Selection rule: an expectation invariant under the center twist through `b` annihilates
every Polyakov-loop observable at `b` of nontrivial center charge `ω ≠ 1`. -/
theorem fixed_zero {x ω : ℂ} (h : x = ω * x) (hω : ω ≠ 1) : x = 0 := by
  have h3 : (ω - 1) * x = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, one_mul, ← h, sub_self]
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hω)

theorem expectation_polyakov_eq_zero [NeZero L] {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d)
    (b : Site d L) (χ : G → ℂ) (ω : ℂ) (hχ : ∀ h, χ (z * h) = ω * χ h) (hω : ω ≠ 1)
    (E : (LinkConfig G d L → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (hE : ∀ F : LinkConfig G d L → ℂ, E (fun U => F (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U)) = E F) :
    E (fun U => χ (polyakovLoop U b τ)) = 0 :=
  fixed_zero ((hE _).symm.trans ((congrArg E (funext fun U =>
    (congrArg χ (polyakovLoop_centerTwist hz τ U b)).trans (hχ _) :
      (fun U => χ (polyakovLoop (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ)) =
        ω • (fun U : LinkConfig G d L => χ (polyakovLoop U b τ)))).trans
    (map_smul E ω _))) hω

/-- Center symmetry of lattice gauge theory on `(ℤ/Lℤ)^d`, for any group `G`, central `z`
and direction `τ`: (1) every plaquette action is invariant under the center twist of any
slice; (2) Polyakov loops are gauge covariant (conjugated at the base point), and the twist
of the slice through `b` multiplies the Polyakov loop at `b` by `z`; (3) every twist-invariant
linear expectation annihilates `χ ∘ P_b` whenever `χ(z h) = ω χ(h)` with `ω ≠ 1`; (4) in the
axial gauge of pr-12, the twisted configuration's residual link on the last slice is `z`
times the original Polyakov loop. -/
theorem result :
    ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] (d L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (z : G), IsCentral z → ∀ τ : Fin d,
      (∀ (t₀ : ZMod L) (f : G → ℝ) (U : LinkConfig G d L),
        latticeAction f (centerTwist z τ t₀ U) = latticeAction f U) ∧
      (∀ (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L),
        polyakovLoop (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ = z * polyakovLoop U b τ ∧
        ∀ g : GaugeTransform G d L,
          polyakovLoop (gaugeAct g U) b τ = g b * polyakovLoop U b τ * (g b)⁻¹) ∧
      (∀ (b : Site d L) (χ : G → ℂ) (ω : ℂ), (∀ h, χ (z * h) = ω * χ h) → ω ≠ 1 →
        ∀ E : (LinkConfig G d L → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ,
          (∀ F : LinkConfig G d L → ℂ, E (fun U => F (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U)) = E F) →
          E (fun U => χ (polyakovLoop U b τ)) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L), (x τ).val + 1 = L →
        ∃ g : GaugeTransform G d L,
          gaugeAct g (centerTwist z τ (sliceBase x τ τ) U) x τ =
            z * polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ) := by
  intro G _ d L _ z hz τ
  refine ⟨fun t₀ f U => latticeAction_centerTwist hz τ t₀ f U,
    fun U b => ⟨polyakovLoop_centerTwist hz τ U b, fun g => polyakovLoop_gaugeAct g U b τ⟩,
    fun b χ ω hχ hω E hE => expectation_polyakov_eq_zero hz τ b χ ω hχ hω E hE,
    fun U x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨g, -, h2, -⟩ :=
    B_4f4126122d0700524796c405e145badf09c1ce0f46ce2280744811f1b2bad118.Contribution.result
      G d L τ (centerTwist z τ (sliceBase x τ τ) U)
  exact ⟨g, (h2 x hx).trans (polyakovLoop_centerTwist hz τ U (sliceBase x τ))⟩

end Contribution

{
  "version": 2,
  "imports": [
    "Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic",
    "Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic",
    "Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LinearMap.Defs"
  ],
  "source": "namespace Contribution

open B_fe98bbfbfb97628232bb09c5964d9ee6fa045bd4f96501a460ab0583772ba5a2.Contribution
open B_4f4126122d0700524796c405e145badf09c1ce0f46ce2280744811f1b2bad118.Contribution

variable {G : Type} [Group G] {d L : ℕ}

/-- `z` lies in the center of `G`. -/
def IsCentral (z : G) : Prop := ∀ h : G, z * h = h * z

/-- The center transformation: right-multiply every `τ`-link leaving the slice `x_τ = t₀`
by `z`. -/
def centerTwist (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) :
    LinkConfig G d L :=
  fun x μ => if μ = τ ∧ x τ = t₀ then U x μ * z else U x μ

theorem twist_ne (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L)
    {μ : Fin d} (h : μ ≠ τ) : centerTwist z τ t₀ U x μ = U x μ :=
  if_neg fun hh => h hh.1

theorem twist_on (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) {x : Site d L}
    {μ : Fin d} (hμ : μ = τ) (h : x τ = t₀) : centerTwist z τ t₀ U x μ = U x μ * z :=
  if_pos ⟨hμ, h⟩

theorem twist_off (z : G) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) {x : Site d L}
    {μ : Fin d} (h : x τ ≠ t₀) : centerTwist z τ t₀ U x μ = U x μ :=
  if_neg fun hh => h hh.2

theorem shift_coord (x : Site d L) {τ ν : Fin d} (h : τ ≠ ν) : (x + e ν : Site d L) τ = x τ := by
  rw [Pi.add_apply, e_ne h, add_zero]

theorem cancel_first {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) {a' b' c' f' : G} (a b c f : G)
    (ha : a' = a * z) (hb : b' = b) (hc : c' = c * z) (hf : f' = f) :
    a' * b' * c'⁻¹ * f'⁻¹ = a * b * c⁻¹ * f⁻¹ := by
  rw [ha, hb, hc, hf, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc a z b, hz b, ← mul_assoc a b z, mul_assoc (a * b) z,
    mul_inv_cancel_left]

theorem four_links {a' b' c' f' : G} (a b c f : G)
    (ha : a' = a) (hb : b' = b) (hc : c' = c) (hf : f' = f) :
    a' * b' * c'⁻¹ * f'⁻¹ = a * b * c⁻¹ * f⁻¹ := by
  subst ha hb hc hf; rfl

/-- Plaquettes with first direction `τ` are unchanged by a center twist. -/
theorem plaquette_centerTwist_first {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L)
    (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L) {μ ν : Fin d} (hμ : μ = τ) (hμν : μ ≠ ν) :
    plaquette (centerTwist z τ t₀ U) x μ ν = plaquette U x μ ν := by
  have hντ : ν ≠ τ := fun h => hμν (hμ.trans h.symm)
  by_cases ht : x τ = t₀
  · exact cancel_first hz _ _ _ _ (twist_on z τ t₀ U hμ ht) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hντ)
      (twist_on z τ t₀ U hμ ((shift_coord x (Ne.symm hντ)).trans ht)) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hντ)
  · exact four_links _ _ _ _ (twist_off z τ t₀ U ht) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hντ)
      (twist_off z τ t₀ U (fun h => ht ((shift_coord x (Ne.symm hντ)).symm.trans h)))
      (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hντ)

/-- Every plaquette is unchanged by a center twist. -/
theorem plaquette_centerTwist {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d) (t₀ : ZMod L)
    (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L) (μ ν : Fin d) :
    plaquette (centerTwist z τ t₀ U) x μ ν = plaquette U x μ ν := by
  by_cases hμν : μ = ν
  · cases hμν
    exact (plaquette_self _ x μ).trans (plaquette_self U x μ).symm
  by_cases hμ : μ = τ
  · exact plaquette_centerTwist_first hz τ t₀ U x hμ hμν
  by_cases hν : ν = τ
  · exact (plaquette_swap _ x ν μ).trans ((congrArg (·⁻¹)
      (plaquette_centerTwist_first hz τ t₀ U x hν (Ne.symm hμν))).trans
      (plaquette_swap U x ν μ).symm)
  · exact four_links _ _ _ _ (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hμ) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hν)
      (twist_ne z τ t₀ U _ hμ) (twist_ne z τ t₀ U x hν)

/-- Every plaquette action (no class-function hypothesis needed) is center-twist invariant. -/
theorem latticeAction_centerTwist [NeZero L] {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d)
    (t₀ : ZMod L) (f : G → ℝ) (U : LinkConfig G d L) :
    latticeAction f (centerTwist z τ t₀ U) = latticeAction f U := by
  unfold latticeAction
  simp only [plaquette_centerTwist hz]

/-! ### Telescoping along a line (abstract sequences) -/

theorem conj_step (gb P h u j : G) : gb * P * h⁻¹ * (h * u * j⁻¹) = gb * (P * u) * j⁻¹ := by
  rw [mul_assoc h u, mul_assoc (gb * P), inv_mul_cancel_left, ← mul_assoc (gb * P) u,
    ← mul_assoc gb P u]

theorem tele_gauge (g P Q u : ℕ → G) (hP0 : P 0 = 1) (hP : ∀ k, P (k + 1) = P k * u k)
    (hQ0 : Q 0 = 1) (hQ : ∀ k, Q (k + 1) = Q k * (g k * u k * (g (k + 1))⁻¹)) :
    ∀ k, Q k = g 0 * P k * (g k)⁻¹
  | 0 => by rw [hQ0, hP0, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel]
  | k + 1 => by rw [hQ, tele_gauge g P Q u hP0 hP hQ0 hQ k, hP, conj_step]

theorem tele_twist {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (N : ℕ) (P Q u : ℕ → G) (hP0 : P 0 = 1)
    (hP : ∀ k, P (k + 1) = P k * u k) (hQ1 : Q 1 = u 0 * z)
    (hQ : ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k < N → Q (k + 1) = Q k * u k) :
    ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ N → Q k = z * P k := by
  intro k hk
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => intro _; rw [hQ1, hP, hP0, one_mul, hz]
  | succ k hk ih =>
    intro hkN
    rw [hQ k hk hkN, ih (Nat.le_of_lt hkN), hP, mul_assoc]

theorem add_L_smul_e [NeZero L] (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) : b + L • e τ = b := by
  funext μ
  rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, nsmul_eq_mul, ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul, add_zero]

theorem shift_succ (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) (k : ℕ) :
    b + k • e τ + e τ = b + (k + 1) • e τ :=
  (add_assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (b + ·) (succ_nsmul _ k).symm)

/-- Polyakov loops transform by conjugation at their base point. -/
theorem polyakovLoop_gaugeAct [NeZero L] (g : GaugeTransform G d L) (U : LinkConfig G d L)
    (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) :
    polyakovLoop (gaugeAct g U) b τ = g b * polyakovLoop U b τ * (g b)⁻¹ := by
  have h := tele_gauge (fun k => g (b + k • e τ)) (linePath U b τ)
    (linePath (gaugeAct g U) b τ) (fun k => U (b + k • e τ) τ) rfl (fun _ => rfl) rfl
    (fun k => congrArg (fun p => linePath (gaugeAct g U) b τ k *
      (g (b + k • e τ) * U (b + k • e τ) τ * (g p)⁻¹)) (shift_succ b τ k)) L
  rw [polyakovLoop, polyakovLoop, h, zero_smul, add_zero, add_L_smul_e]

theorem coord_ne [NeZero L] (b : Site d L) (τ : Fin d) {k : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk : k < L) :
    (b + k • e τ : Site d L) τ ≠ b τ := by
  rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, e_self, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  intro h
  have h0 : ((k : ℕ) : ZMod L) = 0 := add_eq_left.mp h
  rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at h0
  exact absurd (Nat.eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt h0 hk) (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp h1)

/-- A center twist at the slice through `b` multiplies the Polyakov loop at `b` by `z`. -/
theorem polyakovLoop_centerTwist [NeZero L] {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d)
    (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L) :
    polyakovLoop (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ = z * polyakovLoop U b τ := by
  have hb0 : (b + (0 : ℕ) • e τ : Site d L) τ = b τ := by rw [zero_smul, add_zero]
  exact tele_twist hz L (linePath U b τ) (linePath (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ)
    (fun k => U (b + k • e τ) τ) rfl (fun _ => rfl)
    ((one_mul _).trans (twist_on z τ (b τ) U rfl hb0))
    (fun k h1 hk => congrArg (linePath (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ k * ·)
      (twist_off z τ (b τ) U (coord_ne b τ h1 hk)))
    L NeZero.one_le le_rfl

/-- Selection rule: an expectation invariant under the center twist through `b` annihilates
every Polyakov-loop observable at `b` of nontrivial center charge `ω ≠ 1`. -/
theorem fixed_zero {x ω : ℂ} (h : x = ω * x) (hω : ω ≠ 1) : x = 0 := by
  have h3 : (ω - 1) * x = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, one_mul, ← h, sub_self]
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hω)

theorem expectation_polyakov_eq_zero [NeZero L] {z : G} (hz : IsCentral z) (τ : Fin d)
    (b : Site d L) (χ : G → ℂ) (ω : ℂ) (hχ : ∀ h, χ (z * h) = ω * χ h) (hω : ω ≠ 1)
    (E : (LinkConfig G d L → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (hE : ∀ F : LinkConfig G d L → ℂ, E (fun U => F (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U)) = E F) :
    E (fun U => χ (polyakovLoop U b τ)) = 0 :=
  fixed_zero ((hE _).symm.trans ((congrArg E (funext fun U =>
    (congrArg χ (polyakovLoop_centerTwist hz τ U b)).trans (hχ _) :
      (fun U => χ (polyakovLoop (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ)) =
        ω • (fun U : LinkConfig G d L => χ (polyakovLoop U b τ)))).trans
    (map_smul E ω _))) hω

/-- Center symmetry of lattice gauge theory on `(ℤ/Lℤ)^d`, for any group `G`, central `z`
and direction `τ`: (1) every plaquette action is invariant under the center twist of any
slice; (2) Polyakov loops are gauge covariant (conjugated at the base point), and the twist
of the slice through `b` multiplies the Polyakov loop at `b` by `z`; (3) every twist-invariant
linear expectation annihilates `χ ∘ P_b` whenever `χ(z h) = ω χ(h)` with `ω ≠ 1`; (4) in the
axial gauge of pr-12, the twisted configuration's residual link on the last slice is `z`
times the original Polyakov loop. -/
theorem result :
    ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] (d L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (z : G), IsCentral z → ∀ τ : Fin d,
      (∀ (t₀ : ZMod L) (f : G → ℝ) (U : LinkConfig G d L),
        latticeAction f (centerTwist z τ t₀ U) = latticeAction f U) ∧
      (∀ (U : LinkConfig G d L) (b : Site d L),
        polyakovLoop (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U) b τ = z * polyakovLoop U b τ ∧
        ∀ g : GaugeTransform G d L,
          polyakovLoop (gaugeAct g U) b τ = g b * polyakovLoop U b τ * (g b)⁻¹) ∧
      (∀ (b : Site d L) (χ : G → ℂ) (ω : ℂ), (∀ h, χ (z * h) = ω * χ h) → ω ≠ 1 →
        ∀ E : (LinkConfig G d L → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ,
          (∀ F : LinkConfig G d L → ℂ, E (fun U => F (centerTwist z τ (b τ) U)) = E F) →
          E (fun U => χ (polyakovLoop U b τ)) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L), (x τ).val + 1 = L →
        ∃ g : GaugeTransform G d L,
          gaugeAct g (centerTwist z τ (sliceBase x τ τ) U) x τ =
            z * polyakovLoop U (sliceBase x τ) τ) := by
  intro G _ d L _ z hz τ
  refine ⟨fun t₀ f U => latticeAction_centerTwist hz τ t₀ f U,
    fun U b => ⟨polyakovLoop_centerTwist hz τ U b, fun g => polyakovLoop_gaugeAct g U b τ⟩,
    fun b χ ω hχ hω E hE => expectation_polyakov_eq_zero hz τ b χ ω hχ hω E hE,
    fun U x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨g, -, h2, -⟩ :=
    B_4f4126122d0700524796c405e145badf09c1ce0f46ce2280744811f1b2bad118.Contribution.result
      G d L τ (centerTwist z τ (sliceBase x τ τ) U)
  exact ⟨g, (h2 x hx).trans (polyakovLoop_centerTwist hz τ U (sliceBase x τ))⟩

end Contribution

provenance.discovery_basis: On 2026-11-28 I searched the lgt sources (commit b8793ccf) for center, Polyakov, twist and confinement statements and found none. I checked the accepted track records pr-10 and pr-12. Web search for Lean formalizations of lattice center symmetry found nothing beyond unaudited GitHub projects. The search was not exhaustive.

verdict.reason: The contribution formalizes the lattice centre‑twist symmetry, proves invariance of all plaquette actions under the twist, establishes gauge‑covariance of Polyakov loops and derives the standard selection rule that a twist‑invariant linear expectation annihilates centre‑charged Polyakov observables. These results were not present in the existing track contributions (pr‑10 and pr‑12) and therefore constitute a genuine incremental addition to the repository, albeit a formalisation of known physics rather than a new discovery. The theorems are relevant to the overall Yang‑Mills objective as they provide rigorous lattice infrastructure for studying confinement and could be built upon to address the mass‑gap problem, but they do not themselves solve the full problem. The definitions and lemmas are expressed in Lean and can be readily reused in further lattice gauge‑theory developments, such as constructing invariant measures or analyzing phase transitions. Scores reflect moderate novelty (integration of known results), moderate significance (useful step toward confinement analysis), and moderate reusability (provides reusable formal components).
